senses.gloss:
बोध बोध, i. e. बुध् + अ, m.
 1. Knowledge, Bhāṣāp. 140.
 2. Intellect, wisdom.
 3. Arousing.
 --Comp.

बोधक बोधक, i. e. बुध्, Caus., + अक,
 I. adj. Causing to know, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 1.
 II. m.
 1. A teacher.
 2. A spy.

बोधन बोधन, i. e. बुध् + अन,
 I. n., and f. नी.
 1. Knowledge, Ragh. 9, 49.
 2. Teaching.
 3. Arousing, Śiś. 9, 24.
 II. n. Burning incense.
 III. m. The planet Mercury.

बोधि बोधि, i. e. बुध् + इ,
 I. adj. Wise, learned.
 II. m.
 1. Intellect.
 2. The holy fig-tree.
बोधि- + सत्त्व बोधि- + सत्त्व, m. a Bauddha saint.
